changeSet.author: codex

preConditions.onFailMessage: INGESTION_DIRECT_DBT_RETIREMENT_BLOCKED: migrate non-empty dbt_model_selector or dbt_dag_selector values to the canonical Candidate and Materialization chain

and.sqlCheck: SELECT count(*) FROM ingestion_task WHERE nullif(btrim(dbt_model_selector), '') IS NOT NULL OR nullif(btrim(dbt_dag_selector), '') IS NOT NULL

SELECT count(*) FROM pg_constraint constraint_definition WHERE constraint_definition.conrelid = 'ingestion_task'::regclass AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM unnest(constraint_definition.conkey) constrained_column(attnum) JOIN pg_attribute attribute_definition ON attribute_definition.attrelid = constraint_definition.conrelid AND attribute_definition.attnum = constrained_column.attnum WHERE attribute_definition.attname IN ('dbt_model_selector', 'dbt_dag_selector') )

SELECT count(*) FROM pg_index index_definition WHERE index_definition.indrelid = 'ingestion_task'::regclass AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM unnest(index_definition.indkey::smallint[]) indexed_column(attnum) JOIN pg_attribute attribute_definition ON attribute_definition.attrelid = index_definition.indrelid AND attribute_definition.attnum = indexed_column.attnum WHERE attribute_definition.attname IN ('dbt_model_selector', 'dbt_dag_selector') )

SELECT count(DISTINCT dependent_view.oid) FROM pg_depend dependency JOIN pg_rewrite rewrite_rule ON rewrite_rule.oid = dependency.objid JOIN pg_class dependent_view ON dependent_view.oid = rewrite_rule.ev_class JOIN pg_attribute source_column ON source_column.attrelid = dependency.refobjid AND source_column.attnum = dependency.refobjsubid WHERE dependency.refobjid = 'ingestion_task'::regclass AND source_column.attname IN ('dbt_model_selector', 'dbt_dag_selector') AND dependent_view.relkind IN ('v', 'm')

changeSet.comment: Remove the retired ingestion-to-dbt shortcut configuration. Ingestion now publishes source and quality facts; model execution is owned exclusively by ReleaseCandidate and Materialization. Historical task revision JSON and audit evidence remain untouched.
